title: Playing alto with Kid Howard's band
summary: Names the Howard band, about three years of heavy work including the Naval Base, and trombone choices.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: Did you know Kid Howard? Did I know Kid Howard?

Yeah. I played with Kid Howard. I played with Kid Howard a long time. Kid Howard, we had, uh, I was alto, we had Andrew Morgan on the town. Uh, Jim Little, Jim Robinson, Nippa. Yeah, basically. He was on bass. And, uh, Emile O'Reilly was on guitar. And, uh, Edgar Moses was on drum. Then we had, uh, this boy Lewis, Raymond Lewis was on piano. Yeah, I was with Howard about three years. That's when I left Howard and went with Joey Lewis. I mean, Joey Williams. Raymond Lewis? Mm-hmm.

We was playing down by Rockford Lewis place, used to have a hall, huh? The name of all they called Rockford Lewis. And we was working all down in the volley. The clubs down there. Howard had so much work, we had to tell them to turn it down. Working over at the Naval Base, going every night with Howard. Raymond Lewis, I can't play. I knew a guy they called Raymond Dorris. Oh, he's done, yeah. Yeah, that's a different guy. No, Raymond don't play anymore. Hillingman, Broke's Jaw, that club that was playing there. And, uh, uh, uh, he was playing there. And, uh, uh, he was playing with, uh, uh, with, uh, uh, Amil Maurice. I had a club on, uh, uh, uh, uh, Preboz, Hillingman, Broke's Jaw, that club that was playing there. I knew Preboz was the biggest club. Yeah. And he hit who? Preboz, he and him, and Broke's Jaw. Which hymn?
Raymond. Yeah. And, uh, he gave it up after that. Yeah. Cause he was playing with, uh, he had that child over there. I didn't know Preboz did stuff like that.
I know some Preboz couldn't know him. He sure did him.

Yeah. I forget who was playing, who was in charge of that band over there. But there wasn't that a club. Uh, this fella Beck got the bicycle shop. He was running the club on Claymore Avenue out there. They had a nice group. It was a good band.
Who played trompo with Howard? Or did he have a trompo? We didn't have a trompo.

Oh, sometimes we'd use, uh, Jim Robinson. He used Jim Robinson on some jobs. Mostly we didn't have any trombones. Then after a while, he took Paul Barnes in his band. It was, oh, Treesaxe, yeah. Paul Barnes. I worked with him for quite a long while.
